description:
1. ABOUT BYFAS & THE ROLE
BYFAS is seeking a Luxury Sales Consultant who serves not only as a revenue generator but as a true
Brand Ambassador. In this role, you will connect esteemed clients with our brand heritage, fine
craftsmanship, and the artistic spirit of the Maison.
2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 Luxury Client Experience & Sales:
o Welcome and deliver an exceptional, tailor-made luxury shopping experience to clients
visiting the Maison/Showroom.
o Share in-depth knowledge of brand heritage, silk craftsmanship, and artistic value across
product categories: Couture, Couture Áo Dài, Ready-to-Wear, Accessories, etc.
o Guide clients through the complete journey: Consultation $\rightarrow$ Fitting
$\rightarrow$ Styling Proposal $\rightarrow$ Closing $\rightarrow$ After-sales care.
 Clienteling & CRM:
o Build, maintain, and categorize an individual client book (VIP/VVIP, High Potential,
Existing, and New Prospects).
o Record detailed client profiles (style preferences, measurements, key occasions, budget)
to deliver highly personalized styling services.
o Foster long-term relationships through proactive post-purchase follow-ups, private
previews, and special occasion greetings.
 Order Management & Team Collaboration:
o Manage assigned leads across walk-ins, private client lists, social media, events, and
management referrals.
o Coordinate seamlessly with Design, Atelier (Tailoring), and Production teams to ensure
bespoke and made-to-measure orders meet client commitments.
 Brand Representation:
o Maintain impeccable grooming, dress-code standards, and luxury etiquette at all times.
o Uphold Visual Merchandising standards and ensure strict confidentiality regarding client
data and Couture designs.
